name: Alila Diwa Goa
insider_take: Where Goan heritage meets contemporary luxury in the heart of South Goa's serene countryside
whats_special: Alila Diwa Goa sits on 50 acres of lush paddy fields in Majorda, featuring traditional Goan architecture with red-tiled roofs and laterite stone walls. The resort is built around sustainable design principles and offers direct access to pristine Majorda Beach. Its spa incorporates ancient Ayurvedic treatments with modern wellness techniques, while the infinity pool overlooks emerald rice paddies.
pro_tip: Book the paddy field view rooms during monsoon season (June-September) to witness the magical transformation of golden fields into vibrant green landscapes, and enjoy significantly lower rates while experiencing Goa's lush, romantic rainy season.
dont_miss: The resort's organic herb and vegetable garden tour where ingredients are harvested for the restaurants, and the complimentary bicycle rides through local villages to experience authentic Goan rural life. The beachfront location also provides easy access to Colva and Benaulim beaches, famous for their dolphin spotting opportunities.
pros: Contemporary luxury resort with distinctive architecture and design
Multiple dining venues featuring local Goan and international cuisine
Full-service Spa Alila with traditional wellness treatments
Large outdoor swimming pool and fitness facilities
